text:
deploybot: preflight: prompt/eval gate FAILED for release v2.18.0 on summarizer prompt-suite. overall metric: ROUGE-L delta +3.2% (regression), noise increased on 6/50 cases. Blocking promotion unless an exception is approved or a targeted pin/rollback is done. details: https://internal.redwood/evals/4961234567 :warning:

maya: @deploybot can you paste the top failing prompts? need to know if this will hit release notes (customer-facing). also what samples are noisy vs systemic?

deploybot: top failures (shortened):
```
1) "Summarize this email thread" -> hallucinated facts about dates
2) "TL;DR product update" -> lost key bullet on billing change
3) "Short summary for exec" -> repeated unrelated sentence
```
noisy: tests 14, 27, 33 appear flaky across runs. systemic: tests 2, 3, 8 fail consistently.

liam: is this the quant profile change we rolled in yesterday? anyone recall config diffs?

anya: yes, quant-profile v3 -> v4 with int8 rounding tweak. I ran an isolated local eval: reproduced the billing bullet drop on v4. quant rollback to v3 restores baseline.

maya: product perspective: the billing bullet is in release notes and visible to customers. if it gets summarized out we risk support tickets. leaning toward pinning to v3 for public release and then hotfix rolling to v4 after triage. thoughts? :thinking_face:

jin: QA: can confirm repro on v4 in staging with same prompt set. we also saw higher variance on long-context prompts. we can sign off on pin if eng ops can do region-scoped routing.

sam: ops: region-scoped pin is possible for eu-prod only but it will take ~45m to create the route and validate traffic shaping. full global pin is simpler (~20m) but may block some internal backfills.

liam: plan suggestion: 1) pin global to v3 for the release 2) create an internal ticket to bisect quant changes 3) prepare a fast follow patch with quant tweaks and a small canary. Anyone object?

maya: approved from PM side if we pin. please include a short note in release notes: "Serving variant pinned for summarizer to maintain serialization quality; quant improvements to follow." keep wording non-technical.

anya: will run a quick bisect and post findings to the ticket. I think rounding in kernel KERNEL_X is the culprit.

jin: QA will run targeted regression sweep post-pin and confirm no other suites regress.

deploybot: to ops: pin command ready:
```
/deploybot pin-model --service summarizer --model-tag v3 --scope global --reason "preflight eval regression: summarizer prompt-suite"
```
once you run that, I will re-run preflight to confirm gating passes.

sam: executing now. will post completion + verification link when done. :rocket:

sam: pin completed at 4961234590 — deploybot re-run queued.

deploybot: re-run complete at 4961234598: preflight PASS (regression mitigated). markers: ROUGE-L delta +0.1%. marking thread resolved unless QA finds secondary fails.

maya: thanks all — i'll update release notes and ship. leave the bisect ticket open and loop in support for watch. :thumbsup:

liam: filed ticket RD-7892 for bisect + kernel investigation. assigning to @anya. estimated 2d investigation.
